description: Figure: topology-aware cytosolic motif map, observed vs chance expectation, and ortholog conservation of the AVT6 motif
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re
segdf=pd.read_csv("AVT_all_segments_topology.csv"); bg=pd.read_csv("AVT_motif_permutation_background.csv")
oh=pd.read_csv("AVT6_ortholog_motif_conservation.csv")
order=["AVT1","AVT2","AVT3","AVT4","AVT5","AVT6","AVT7"]
pat=re.compile(r'(?=([DE]...L[LI]))')

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16,5.2),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.5,1.1,0.9]})

# Panel A: topology map, cytosolic segments highlighted, motif positions marked
ax=axes[0]
for k,g in enumerate(order):
    y=len(order)-k
    sub=segdf[segdf.gene==g]
    L=int(sub.end.max())
    ax.plot([1,L],[y,y],color="#d9822b",lw=9,solid_capstyle="butt",zorder=1)   # background = TM
    for _,r in sub.iterrows():
        col="#3a6ea5" if r.parity_call=="Cytoplasmic" else "#c9ccd1"
        ax.plot([r.start,r.end],[y,y],color=col,lw=9,solid_capstyle="butt",zorder=2)
        if r.parity_call=="Cytoplasmic":
            for m in pat.finditer(str(r.seq)):
                p=m.start(1)+int(r.start)
                ax.plot(p,y+0.30,marker="v",color="#c0392b",ms=10,zorder=4)
                ax.text(p,y+0.44,"%s\n%d"%(m.group(1),p),ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=7.5,color="#c0392b")
    ax.text(-22,y,g,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=11,fontweight="bold")
ax.set_xlim(-170,780); ax.set_ylim(0.4,8.0); ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel("residue position")
ax.set_title("A. Scanning all predicted cytosolic segments, loops included\nblue = cytosolic, grey = lumenal, orange = TM, red = [DE]xxxL[LI]",fontsize=10,loc="left")
for s in ("top","right","left"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# Panel B: observed vs chance expectation
ax=axes[1]
x=np.arange(len(order))
exp=[bg.loc[bg.gene==g,"expected_by_chance"].iloc[0] for g in order]
ob =[bg.loc[bg.gene==g,"observed"].iloc[0] for g in order]
ax.bar(x-0.19,ob,0.38,label="observed",color="#c0392b")
ax.bar(x+0.19,exp,0.38,label="expected by chance\n(20,000 within-protein shuffles)",color="#8d95a0")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(order,rotation=30,ha="right",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("[DE]xxxL[LI] matches in cytosolic surface")
ax.set_ylim(0,1.35); ax.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False)
ax.set_title("B. Motif is so rare that absence carries no information\nfamily-wide observed 2 vs expected 1.62, Poisson P=0.48",fontsize=10,loc="left")
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
for i,g in enumerate(order):
    p=bg.loc[bg.gene==g,"P_at_least_one_by_chance"].iloc[0]
    ax.text(i,max(ob[i],exp[i])+0.07,"P(>=1)\n%.2f"%p,ha="center",fontsize=7,color="#55595f")

# Panel C: ortholog conservation of the AVT6 motif
ax=axes[2]
with_m=int((oh.n_DExxxLLI_whole_protein>0).sum()); without=len(oh)-with_m
ax.bar([0,1],[with_m,without],color=["#2e9e6b","#c0392b"],width=0.6)
ax.set_xticks([0,1]); ax.set_xticklabels(["has >=1 motif\nanywhere","no motif\nanywhere"],fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("fungal AVT6 orthologs (n=%d)"%len(oh))
ax.set_title("C. AVT6 is a demonstrated vacuolar exporter,\nyet 8/19 orthologs lack the motif entirely",fontsize=10,loc="left")
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
for i,v in enumerate([with_m,without]): ax.text(i,v+0.2,str(v),ha="center",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
